topics.description: The Minnesota Attorney General's lawsuit against nonprofit leaders over an alleged $6.5 million fraud is gaining attention.
topics.reason: The large amount of money involved and the fact that it involves nonprofit leaders makes this a trending topic.

topics.description: The strengthening of the Somali fraud probe by Minnesota lawmakers is also gaining attention.
topics.reason: The involvement of lawmakers and the potential for new developments in the investigation makes this a trending topic.
